You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Question: On 1 March 2027 a company that is neither the original manufacturer nor a non-professional user carries out a substantial modification of a machine placed on the market in February 2027. In what capacity (as which economic operator) does it answer for that machine under the act applicable on that day?

Facts:
[0] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | becomes manufacturer | shall not be considered to be a manufacturer | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Machinery Regulation), Article 51(2) first subparagraph, as corrected by the corrigendum | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20] [matched by relation]
[2] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18]
[3] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18]
[4] fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[5] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[6] visual check of the machine and the protective device | requires periodic check | daily (P1D) | if: In many cases, it makes sense to carry out the following thorough checks daily | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 51]
[7] relevant economic operator | has obligation | take all appropriate measures | if: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds | [REG, Art. 45(1)]
[8] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to withdraw that product or to recall it | if: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds | [REG, Art. 45(1)]
[9] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[10] surfaces in contact with foodstuffs | requires measure | have neither ridges nor crevices | if: other than surfaces of disposable parts | [DIR, Annex I, 2.1.1]
[11] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC | placing allowed until | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027 | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[12] control devices (1.2.2) | requires measure | an acoustic and/or visual warning signal | if: If neither of these possibilities is applicable, before the machinery starts | [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.2]
[13] importer or distributor | has obligation | subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10… ("") | if: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies… | [REG, Art. 17]
[14] datore di lavoro utilizzatore | has obligation | apposita prescrizione a rimuovere tale situazione | if: nel caso in cui sia stata accertata una contravvenzione | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[15] economic operators | has obligation | shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 19(1)]
[16] relevant economic operator | has obligation | take appropriate and proportionate corrective action | if: the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this… | [REG, Art. 43(1)]
[17] economic operator, products it made available on the market | has obligation | shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken | [REG, Art. 43(3)]
[18] economic operator | has obligation | shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken | if: the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union | [REG, Art. 45(2)]
[19] manufacturer, non-professional users | has obligation | provide, in paper format… | if: in the case of machinery intended for non-professional users or that can be used by non-professional users | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[20] UNIVPM equipment guideline, Art. 10(7): manufacturer's duty to provide safety information on paper for machinery usable by non-professional users | has obligation | the manufacturer shall provide, in paper format… | if: In the case of machinery or a related product intended for non-professional users or that can, under reasonably foreseeable conditions, be used by non-professional users… | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[21] machinery or related product before start | requires measure | an acoustic and/or visual warning signal shall be given | if: if neither of these possibilities is applicable | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.2]
[22] economic operator | defined as | means the manufacturer, the authorised representative | [REG, Art. 3(22)]
[23] impianti di messa a terra | requires check after | variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione… | [inail-guide, p. 15]
[24] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[25] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[26] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[27] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | must ensure | if: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[28] partly completed machinery | must accompany | EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B | if: or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code | [REG, Art. 11(8)]

[30] carrelli semoventi a braccio telescopico | has obligation | comunicazione di messa in servizio all’Unità operativa territoriale dell’Inail competente all’atto della… | [inail-guide, p. 27]
[31] datore di lavoro (Plac) | has obligation | comunicazione di messa in servizio all’Unità operativa territoriale dell’Inail competente all’atto della… | if: Per le Plac | [inail-guide, p. 28]
[32] datore di lavoro (ascensori e montacarichi da cantiere) | has obligation | comunicazione di messa in servizio all’Unità operativa territoriale dell’Inail competente all’atto della… | if: Per ascensori e montacarichi da cantiere | [inail-guide, p. 28]
[33] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[34] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[35] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[36] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV… | if: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market | [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[37] professional user | defined as | a natural person who uses or operates machinery | if: in the course of his or her professional activity or work | [REG, Art. 3(36)]
[38] distributors | has obligation | act with due care in relation to the requirements of this Regulation | if: When making machinery or a related product available on the market | [REG, Art. 15(1)]
[39] distributors of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall act with due care | if: When making partly completed machinery available on the market | [REG, Art. 16(1)]
[40] personnel of a conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall observe professional secrecy | if: except in relation to the competent authorities of the Member State in which its tasks are carried out | [REG, Art. 30(10)]
[41] user of nanoScan3 data output | integrator responsible for | the user must define and implement additional required measures | if: If the data output is to be used in safety functions | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 94]
[42] integrator | integrator responsible for | the integrator is responsible for the completed machine fulfiling all applicable Directives | [ur5e-manual, p. 220]
[43] integrator | integrator responsible for | the completed machine fulfiling all applicable Directives… | if: When this partly completed machine is integrated and becomes a complete machine | [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[44] wording and layout of the instructions for use | has obligation | shall take into account the level of general education and acumen | if: In the case of machinery or related products intended for use by non-professional operators | [REG, Annex III, 1.7.4.1]
[45] wording and layout of instructions for use | has obligation | must take into account the level of general education | if: In the case of machinery intended for use by non-professional operators | [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4.1]
[46] importer or distributor | becomes manufacturer | where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of… ("") | if: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies… | [REG, Art. 17]
[47] UR5e robot arm (Universal Robots e-Series) – whether it may be put into service on its own as delivered by the manufacturer | put into service only when | shall only be put into service upon being integrated into a final… | if: which conforms with the provisions of the Machinery Directive and other applicable Directives | [ur5e-manual, p. 220]
[48] relevant economic operators | has obligation | shall cooperate as necessary | if: for that purpose | [REG, Art. 43(1)]
[49] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[50] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[51] Date in the first sentence of Article 52(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (transitional provisions), as corrected by corrigendum point 6 | has time limit | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[52] Directive 2006/42/EC | repealed from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[53] Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[54] Date in Article 54, second paragraph, of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, as corrected by CORR point 10 (page 39) | has time limit | read: ‘ 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[55] Article 50(1) | applies from | 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12] [note: 2027-03-01 is 132 days after 2026-10-20]

response.text: {"reasoning": "On 2027-03-01, the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies, since it applies from 2027-01-20 (facts 53, 1), and the Directive 2006/42/EC was repealed from that same date (fact 52). The modifier is neither the original manufacturer nor a non-professional user, so facts 0 and 5 do not apply. A person carrying out a substantial modification, defined in fact 9, must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility (fact 2). Under Article 18, it is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, but fact 3 carries a condition: this applies if the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly. The condition is truncated in the facts, so I can only state it as given.", "kind": "text", "value": "As a manufacturer: under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 18, a company carrying out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, and must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility, where the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly.", "text": "On 1 March 2027 the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies, and the Directive 2006/42/EC has been repealed. Under Article 18, the company that carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer, so it must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility, subject to the condition in Article 18 that the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly.", "used": [1, 2, 3, 9, 52, 53]}
